_que_es: Monedas, premios y tesoros (set A, el que dio la referencia de estilo). Hoja 3x3 de íconos estilo HUD de los hits: python tools/imagegen.py prompt skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/monedas-premios.json --ref skills/_shared/iconos/referencia-estilo.png

ia.prompt: Icons, left to right and top to bottom: 1) a stack of three shiny gold coins with a star emblem, 2) a thick stack of green cash bills with a paper band, 3) a faceted bright blue diamond gem, 4) a gift box with a red ribbon and a big bow, 5) a wooden treasure chest overflowing with gold coins, 6) a golden trophy cup, 7) a spotted golden egg, 8) a royal golden crown with red and blue jewels, 9) a yellow five-point star.
